SERVICES

What we do

Multiple trades, one contractor. Every job is scoped and quoted before work begins.

01

General maintenance & renovation

Full or partial renovation of homes, offices, apartments and villas — from a single room refresh to a complete unit strip-out and rebuild.

02

Deep cleaning

Professional post-renovation and move-in/move-out deep cleaning for apartments, villas and offices. Uniformed staff and a thorough finish so the space is handover-ready.

03

Paint work

Interior and exterior painting with proper surface preparation, crack treatment and clean edges for apartments, villas and commercial units.

04

AC servicing

Routine servicing and repair of AC units to keep systems running efficiently through the year.

05

Gypsum board partitions & false ceilings

Partition walls and false ceiling installation, removal and reinstatement for residential and commercial fit-outs, including associated finishing work.

06

Tiling & flooring

Tile fixing and repair, plus supply and installation of SPC and other flooring types.

07

Electrical & plumbing

Fault-finding, repair and installation work for electrical circuits and plumbing lines, including leak detection behind walls and fixtures.

08

Structured cabling

Data and network cabling for offices and residential units — laying, termination and testing — delivered alongside other fit-out or renovation works.

ONGOING COVERAGE

Annual Maintenance Contracts

For property owners, managers and real estate companies who'd rather not wait for something to break, Tafirud offers Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) covering AC, electrical, plumbing and general upkeep under a single agreement. Instead of booking a different contractor every time something needs attention, one scheduled arrangement keeps your property looked after year-round — with priority scheduling when an issue does come up, and a documented service history your building management can rely on.

  • Scheduled inspections & servicing
  • Priority response for contract clients
  • All trades under one agreement
  • Documented service history
